THE COUNT THE 2026-08-29 REPAIR SAID NOBODY HAD. `chg:a-cross-type-near-match-is-named-as-a-layer` rejected the behavioural repair (option ① — exclude the prescribed layer pairs from the filter) with one stated reason and only one: "Nobody has counted how often a cross-type hit IS a real duplicate, so suppressing the check would act on an unmeasured assumption." Two independent field reports on 2026-08-31 supply the count, and the triage session then added two more by incurring them.

**14 near-match refusals. 14 judged distinct. 0 real duplicates.**

- **bhome (8 hits)**, a shipping-container aquaponics build — art:bhome-genesis-feedback-2026-08-31, lines 386-650. Three workflow shapes: Requirement + the Capability created to satisfy it (×4, the golden thread); ChangeEvent + the Decision authorising it (×3, the change loop); an open idea Decision + the Decision that settles it (×1, promotion via EVOLVES_INTO, which is step 5 of the brainstorm skill). Its words: "All six false positives are pairs the tool's own workflows create by design."
- **musicjug (4 hits)**, a browser rhythm game for a 9-year-old — art:musicjug-genesis-feedback-2026-08-31. All four cross-type, all four distinct, tabulated: cap:note-highway vs req:vertical-note-highway; dec:two-speed-synthesis vs the brainstorm idea it promoted; dec:shaping-controls vs ditto; dec:one-clock vs comp:clock. Its words: "the guard's highest-frequency firings are on the three pairings the design WANTS to look similar."
- **This triage session (2 hits), and these are the only ones not self-reported by an agent grading its own work.** Writing `dec:idea-the-near-match-repair-can-now-be-reopened-because-the-count-exists` was refused TWICE: first against the measurement that motivates it (a FIFTH pairing — TemporalFact ↔ the Decision it informs), then, carrying `distinct_from` for that one, against TWO FURTHER nodes the first refusal had never mentioned.

⭐ THE TWO REPORTS AGREE ON THE TAXONOMY WITHOUT HAVING SEEN EACH OTHER. Both independently name Capability↔Requirement and promoted-idea↔settling-Decision. musicjug adds Decision↔Component; bhome adds ChangeEvent↔Decision; this session adds TemporalFact↔Decision. Five pairings, three observers, one conclusion.

🛑 AND THE MITIGATION HAS DEFEATED THE CHECK, WHICH IS THE PART THAT CHANGES THE VERDICT. bhome, at its eighth hit: "I have stopped treating each as noteworthy and started passing `distinct_from` pre-emptively, which is itself the concerning outcome: a guard that is routinely pre-empted has stopped being a check." Option ① was rejected because suppressing the check would trade a false alarm for a silent miss. The measurement says the silent miss ARRIVED ANYWAY, by the other route: an agent that pre-declares `distinct_from` before every write is no longer being checked at all, and unlike a suppression it leaves no record of the trade.

🛑 AND THE PRE-EMPTION DOES NOT EVEN WORK IN ONE CALL — measured here, not reported. The refusal returns ONE LAYER of the near-match set, so clearing it can surface a fresh layer. The cost per write is therefore N round trips, unbounded and discovered one at a time, each re-sending the full node body (~4 KB here, three times). bhome recorded that re-send cost separately in part 6 without connecting it to this. **That is a defect independent of how the guard is tuned: the refusal should return the whole set so `distinct_from` can be answered once.**

📌 WHAT THIS DOES NOT SETTLE: the 12 field hits were judged distinct by the agents that wrote them, and nobody has audited whether any WAS a duplicate the agent talked itself past. The number is a lower bound on the false-positive rate, not a proven zero. The 2 in-session hits are exempt from that caveat — they were incurred rather than observed.
